Action.name: Action
Action.tip: High dynamic lighting and warm rim-lighting are critical to pop against fast-paced Steam browse feeds.

Adventure.name: Adventure
Adventure.tip: Atmospheric lighting with high tonal entropy and clear environmental depth performs best.

RPG.name: RPG
RPG.tip: Deep textural richness and unobstructed character silhouettes with prominent title branding.

Strategy.name: Strategy
Strategy.tip: Sharp typographic contrast and distinct iconography. Avoid oversaturated neon washes.

Simulation.name: Simulation
Simulation.tip: Balanced, inviting color temperatures with crisp line art and clear theme cues.

Casual.name: Casual
Casual.tip: Vibrant, cheerful color palettes with higher average brightness and clean geometric shapes.

Indie.name: Indie
Indie.tip: Distinct stylized visual identity with strong hero focus to stand out from AAA realism.

Racing.name: Racing
Racing.tip: High-velocity motion diagonals and hyper-reflective specular highlights on vehicular hero assets.

Sports.name: Sports
Sports.tip: Dynamic athlete action poses with saturated stadium stadium-lit contrast and clean typographic badges.

Massively Multiplayer.name: Massively Multiplayer
Massively Multiplayer.tip: Epic scale panoramic backdrops featuring grouped heroes or massive faction armadas.

Free To Play.name: Free To Play
Free To Play.tip: Instant visual accessibility with high saturation and bold, easily readable hero characters.

Early Access.name: Early Access
Early Access.tip: Polished key visual polish that instills immediate confidence and production value.

Auto Battler.name: Auto Battler
Auto Battler.tip: Auto Battlers require crisp unit silhouette contrast and distinct character color coding so armies are readable at small scale.

Roguelike Deckbuilder.name: Roguelike Deckbuilder
Roguelike Deckbuilder.tip: High typographic contrast and bold card/rune iconography with warm accent glows create an addictive visual presence.

Action Roguelike.name: Action Roguelike
Action Roguelike.tip: Punchy kinetic lighting with warm bursts (embers, lightning, magic) anchored by a prominent central protagonist.

Metroidvania.name: Metroidvania
Metroidvania.tip: Deep multi-plane atmospheric lighting and distinct silhouetted landscapes with rich textural depth.

Souls-like.name: Souls-like
Souls-like.tip: Deep chiaroscuro shadows with piercing key highlights (golden grace, bonfires, arcane glow) and monolithic scale.

Survival Horror.name: Survival Horror
Survival Horror.tip: Heavy dark-ratio edge vignetting with isolated warm flashlight/crimson illumination on the threat subject.

Cozy Sim.name: Cozy Sim
Cozy Sim.tip: Vibrant, inviting color temperatures with warm golden hour tones and soft, welcoming character design.

Turn-Based Tactics.name: Turn-Based Tactics
Turn-Based Tactics.tip: Clean isometric/grid clarity with deliberate edge line density and clear faction heraldry.

Turn-Based Strategy.name: Turn-Based Strategy
Turn-Based Strategy.tip: Rich strategic map depth with prominent empire crests and crisp territorial contrast.

City Builder.name: City Builder
City Builder.tip: Expansive landscape panoramas with rich structural edge density and natural environmental lighting.

Retro FPS.name: Retro FPS
Retro FPS.tip: Saturated, aggressive color palettes with fiery contrast and high-velocity central focus.

Dragons.name: Dragons
Dragons.tip: Epic creature scale with warm fiery or arcane lighting accents cutting through dark atmospheric skies.

PvP.name: PvP
PvP.tip: Opposing color clashes (red vs blue, gold vs shadow) indicating intense multiplayer competition.

PvE.name: PvE
PvE.tip: Heroic squad lineup facing formidable boss silhouettes in evocative fantasy or sci-fi environments.

Fantasy.name: Fantasy
Fantasy.tip: Luminous magical particle effects and rich mystical textures with clear character silhouettes.

Magic.name: Magic
Magic.tip: Radiant spell glow effects with high luminous contrast against shadowed mystical backdrops.

Medieval.name: Medieval
Medieval.tip: Grit, burnished armor sheen, and torchlit atmosphere with distinct heraldic color banners.

Military.name: Military
Military.tip: Camouflage textures balanced by sharp tactical orange/amber HUD elements and distinct hardware silhouettes.

Wargame.name: Wargame
Wargame.tip: Detailed tactical battle maps and unit counters with disciplined typographic contrast.

Card Game.name: Card Game
Card Game.tip: Embossed card borders with saturated gem/mana accents and readable card art at browse scales.

Pixel Graphics.name: Pixel Graphics
Pixel Graphics.tip: Crisp pixel cluster readability with bold color separation avoiding visual noise at small thumbnail sizes.

Cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk
Cyberpunk.tip: Vibrant cyan/magenta neon contrast cutting through rain-slicked dark industrial geometry.

Open World.name: Open World
Open World.tip: Dramatic vanishing point horizon with atmospheric haze separating foreground protagonist from expansive world.

Sci-fi.name: Sci-fi
Sci-fi.tip: Sleek geometric paneling with electric laser blue or solar orange emissive lighting lines.

Co-op.name: Co-op
Co-op.tip: Multiple complementary character silhouettes showing distinct classes or comedic camaraderie.

Multiplayer.name: Multiplayer
Multiplayer.tip: Kinetic confrontation energy with clear opposing faction visuals and high-saliency action focal points.
